deviations.what: The class is built as substr(cpc_subclass, 1, 3), cutting the four-character CPC subclass (e.g. H04L) down to its three-character CPC class (H04), so different subclasses get merged and the counts in B, F and new_classes come out wrong.

notes: Everything else matches the spec: dating by filing year, the first-listed filter, dropping missing classes, base window t-5..t-1, forward window t+1..t+3 with year t left out of both, NA for an empty base, 0 when there are no forward patents, joins done per firm, and one unique output row per firm-year with the required columns.
